newsitem.title: USA: Continental Express to expand fleet.
newsitem.headline: Continental Express to expand fleet.

text.p: Continental Express Inc, a unit of Continental Airlines Inc, said on Tuesday it placed a five-year order for 25 Embraer EMB-145 50-seat regional jets, valued at $375 million.
The purchase is part of the regional carrier's "flexible growth" plan out of its hub franchises in Newark, N.J., Houston and Cleveland, Continental said.
Continental said the order includes an option for 175 aircraft over the next 12 years, Continental said.

Continental said the option for 175 Embraer aircraft will provide Continental Express with flexibility for additional growth or the replacement of its existing 100-aircraft turboprop fleet over the next decade.
